overview.title: The custom controller
overview.description: A custom controller built for Space Age Racer. Pull a lever, hit the boost, or open the case to see how it works.

left.title: Left lever
left.description: Controls the left engine independently. Move both levers together to accelerate, or offset them to steer the pod racer.

right.title: Right lever
right.description: Controls the right engine independently. Steering comes from the difference in power between the two engines, just like a pod racer.

boost.title: Boost button
boost.description: A push button in the right grip. The Arduino reads each press and how long it is held to drive the in-game boost.

arduino.title: Arduino Uno
arduino.description: The link between the controller and the game. It reads the lever positions and boost button, then sends those inputs to the game.

potentiometers.title: Left potentiometer
potentiometers.description: Converts the left lever's rotation into a value the Arduino reads to set the left engine's power.

potentiometerRight.title: Right potentiometer
potentiometerRight.description: Converts the right lever's rotation into a value the Arduino reads to set the right engine's power.
